_comment: CODE VARIANT of ctc_consistency_rules.json, for value_mode code (cells hold the NCCR notation). Same rules, values written as codes: sex 2 is Female, icccMajor 05 is V. Retinoblastoma, ageRecode19Groups 00/01/02 are 00 years, 01-04 years and 05-09 years. The five Gleason variables repair a female record to their own not-applicable code X8 from the NCCR metadata. psaLabValueRecode repairs to NULL (blank) because its metadata has no not-applicable code (XX.9 means not documented, not assessed or unknown, which is a real answer).
